name: Does AKN Design Group provide guidance on hardware maintenance and longevity for renovated cabinets?

mainEntity.name: Does AKN Design Group provide guidance on hardware maintenance and longevity for renovated cabinets?

acceptedAnswer.text: While cabinet hardware is generally low maintenance, AKN Design Group provides practical advice on caring for your selected finishes to ensure their longevity and sustained beauty after your renovation is complete. We recommend using non-abrasive cleaners and soft cloths to avoid damaging the finish. Specific care instructions can vary by material and finish type. Our commitment to the homeowner experience extends beyond installation, offering insights to help maintain the craftsmanship and quality of your luxury kitchen or spa-inspired bathroom, ensuring lasting impressions and continued satisfaction.
acceptedAnswer.description: AKN Design Group offers advice on maintaining your selected hardware finishes using non-abrasive cleaners to ensure longevity and sustained beauty.
